entries.readiness_missing: new evidence satisfying a reopen condition for pre-2015 origin-state completeness
entries.resolution_basis: Current evidence routes are exhausted: exact cross-feed transfer is not supported, finite forward warmup is falsified, same-source Exness history before 2015-08-10 is not established, and no finite historical anchor domain is established.
entries.reopen_condition: Verified same-source Exness history before 2015-08-10, an independently justified finite domain covering every possible active pre-start origin anchor, or a separately authorized source-backed lifecycle semantic change.

entries.readiness_missing: window-level continuity/gap eligibility for every later canonical replay interval if the seed blocker is ever closed
entries.resolution_basis: Eligibility is determined per requested interval from archive manifest, gap ledger, and half-open window validation rather than from a universal continuity assumption.
entries.observation_method: Run the existing archive-window/gap guards for each future canonical replay interval and persist its eligibility/provenance result.

entries.readiness_missing: exact cross-server/feed equivalence to the target Exness Demo/MT5 runtime where required for execution claims
entries.resolution_basis: Archive-vs-current-runtime overlap is descriptive and the frozen Dukascopy/Exness sensitivity work demonstrates that exact feed-state relabeling cannot be assumed.
entries.reduction_condition: Obtain direct broker/server identity evidence or a same-feed execution-quality historical route that removes the cross-server/feed ambiguity for the intended execution claim.

entries.readiness_missing: historical/current-runtime fill slippage evidence sufficient for economic claims
entries.resolution_basis: Historical market ticks do not by themselves establish actual order fills/slippage; current-runtime fill evidence has not yet been collected under a frozen supervised execution protocol.
entries.reduction_condition: Acquire execution/deal evidence under a separately authorized supervised protocol and explicitly define any residual historical execution uncertainty; do not infer fills from Bid-chart contact alone.

entries.readiness_missing: commission/fee/swap treatment where material for economic P&L
entries.resolution_basis: Current symbol metadata exposes swap fields and account deal history is readable, but representative trade-level cost treatment has not been frozen.
entries.observation_method: Use runtime symbol/account metadata and actual deal records under the authorized environment, then freeze the economic-cost representation before any profitability claim.

entries.readiness_missing: source-compatible trade stop geometry for trade-level P&L
entries.resolution_basis: Current frozen research lifecycle has chart-state point-check/terminal semantics but no source-backed universal trade stop geometry for realized P&L.
entries.reopen_condition: Freeze a source-backed or explicit user-direct trade invalidation/stop convention before outcome scoring; do not derive it from favorable backtests.

entries.resolution_basis: Position sizing is a risk/policy convention and is not defined by current source evidence.
entries.reopen_condition: Receive and freeze an explicit user-direct or separately justified risk-sizing convention before any supervised execution pilot.

entries.resolution_basis: No canonical user-direct or engineering risk cap is currently frozen.
entries.reopen_condition: Receive and freeze an explicit risk-cap convention before any supervised execution pilot.

entries.readiness_missing: authorized pristine/future confirmation under frozen version
entries.resolution_basis: Holdout tooling and activation locks exist; the future/pristine confirmation is intentionally not yet opened or scored.
entries.observation_method: Observe only through the frozen holdout activation protocol when authorization conditions are satisfied; boundary passage alone does not authorize access.

entries.resolution_basis: Version identity can be frozen from governed project state after upstream decision-critical blockers are closed.
entries.derivation_method: Derive the final version identity from canonical state, contracts, and implementation checkpoints before pilot activation; do not select it from holdout outcomes.

entries.resolution_basis: The project already records deterministic state/provenance; pilot-facing presentation can be engineered without inventing market semantics.
entries.derivation_method: Build the reason/audit output from frozen decision state, provenance, fail-closed reasons, and version identity.

entries.resolution_basis: Existing collectors, manifests, gap ledgers, and provenance guards already expose the inputs needed for fail-closed health behavior.
entries.derivation_method: Compose pilot-facing health states from existing collector status, manifest validation, continuity/gap eligibility, and provenance mismatch guards.

entries.resolution_basis: Execution risk conventions are intentionally not inferred from research outcomes and remain undefined until execution is separately authorized.
entries.reopen_condition: Freeze explicit trade/risk conventions, including sizing and risk cap dependencies, before supervised execution.

entries.resolution_basis: Git/checkpoint/version identity infrastructure already exists; pilot rollback workflow can be composed from it.
entries.derivation_method: Bind pilot state to immutable version/checkpoint identifiers and define rollback to the prior verified checkpoint without rewriting history.
